import hashlib,json,resource,time
from pathlib import Path
from orchestrator.defs.bootstrap.moneyflow_history_cohort import freeze_moneyflow_history_cohort
from orchestrator.defs.bootstrap.moneyflow_history_source import PsqlMoneyflowHistorySource
root=Path('/private/tmp/moneyflow-selected-20261008/prod-readonly')
started=time.monotonic()
manifest=freeze_moneyflow_history_cohort(staging_root=root,operation_id='selected-dates-audit',cutoff='2026-09-30',selected_dates=('2024-12-19','2026-09-30'),source=PsqlMoneyflowHistorySource())
operation=root/'moneyflow/selected-dates-audit'
progress=json.loads((operation/'progress.json').read_text())
proofs={str(p.relative_to(operation)):json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in operation.rglob('proof.json')}
sql={str(p.relative_to(operation)):{'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'sql':p.read_text()} for p in operation.rglob('source.sql')}
assert len(proofs)==len(sql)==14
assert all(v['sql'].startswith('BEGIN READ ONLY;') and v['sql'].endswith('ROLLBACK;\n') and 'IN (DATE' in v['sql'] for v in sql.values())
assert not list(operation.rglob('*.parquet'))
result={'scope':'actual Prod read-only aggregate; no business rows or Lake/DG/Prod writes','elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'peak_rss_bytes':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'manifest':manifest,'progress':progress,'metadata_proofs':proofs,'executed_sql':sql}
(root/'evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'total_rows':manifest['total_rows'],'total_dates':manifest['total_dates'],'total_units':manifest['total_units'],'source_requests':progress['copy_transactions'],'sql_statements':progress['sql_statements'],'elapsed_seconds':result['elapsed_seconds'],'peak_rss_mib':result['peak_rss_bytes']/1024**2,'rows':{ds:f['rows'] for ds,f in manifest['plans'].items()},'missing_dates':manifest['missing_dates']},ensure_ascii=False))

import hashlib,json,resource,runpy,time
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
m=runpy.run_path('tests/test_moneyflow_history_selected_dates.py')
m['engine'].shutil.disk_usage=lambda _:SimpleNamespace(free=128*1024**3)
real=json.loads(Path('/private/tmp/moneyflow-selected-20261008/prod-readonly/evidence.json').read_text())
rows={}; fixtures={}
for ds in m['DATASETS']:
    schema=[c.name for c in m['history_schema'](ds)]
    path=Path('tests/fixtures')/(ds+'_20260930.json')
    if path.exists():
        fixture=json.loads(path.read_text(),parse_float=Decimal)
        fixtures[ds]={'path':str(path),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'kind':'20260930 public fixture values; early dates/counts synthetic'}
    else:
        fixture=[m['Source'].row(ds)];fixture[0]['net_amount']='-123456.7890'
        fixtures[ds]={'kind':'synthetic market negative/null values'}
    rows[ds]=[]
    for day in m['DATES']:
        n=sum(f['rows'] for f in real['manifest']['snapshots'][ds]['facts'] if f['trade_date']==day)
        eligible=[r for r in fixture if ds!='moneyflow_ind_dc' or day==m['CUTOFF'] or r['content_type']=='行业']
        for i in range(n):
            item={f:eligible[i%len(eligible)].get(f) for f in schema};item['trade_date']=day
            if i>=len(eligible):
                if 'ts_code' in item:item['ts_code']='888888.TI'
                if 'name' in item:item['name']='隔离额外名称'
            if ds=='moneyflow_ind_dc' and day==m['DATES'][0]:item['ts_code']=None
            rows[ds].append(item)
source=m['Source'](rows)
source.mutate=lambda value:{**value,'columns':real['manifest']['snapshots'][value['dataset']]['columns']}
root=Path('/private/tmp/moneyflow-selected-20261008/isolated-reviewed')
root.mkdir();staging=root/'staging';lake=root/'lake';lake.mkdir()
start=time.monotonic(); built=m['build'](staging,source,expected_cohort_hash=real['manifest']['cohort_hash']); build_seconds=time.monotonic()-start
manifest=m['read'](staging,'cohort.json')
assert manifest['snapshots']==real['manifest']['snapshots']
assert manifest['cohort_hash']==real['manifest']['cohort_hash']
checkpoint_hashes={str(p.relative_to(m['root'](staging))):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in m['root'](staging).rglob('checkpoint.json')}
args={'staging_root':staging,'lake_root':lake,'operation_id':'sample','cutoff':m['CUTOFF'],'selected_dates':m['DATES']}
start=time.monotonic(); planned=m['promote'].promote_moneyflow_history_cohort(**args); preflight_seconds=time.monotonic()-start
assert not m['hashes'](lake)
start=time.monotonic(); applied=m['promote'].promote_moneyflow_history_cohort(**args,apply=True); apply_seconds=time.monotonic()-start
observed=m['hashes'](lake)
assert len(observed)==28 and applied['promoted_rows']==29783
start=time.monotonic(); replay=m['promote'].promote_moneyflow_history_cohort(**args,apply=True); replay_seconds=time.monotonic()-start
assert m['hashes'](lake)==observed
assert not list(m['root'](staging).rglob('*.parquet'))
assert all(hashlib.sha256((m['root'](staging)/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in checkpoint_hashes.items())
assert len(source.requests)==applied['copy_transactions']==replay['copy_transactions']==42
result={'kind':'isolated public fixture numeric values; early day values synthesized; actual Prod count/type/scope metadata matched; not real source business proof','fixture_sources':fixtures,'manifest':manifest,'seconds':{'candidates':build_seconds,'preflight':preflight_seconds,'apply':apply_seconds,'replay':replay_seconds},'peak_rss_bytes':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'total_rows':29783,'files':28,'formal_parquet_bytes':sum(p.stat().st_size for p in lake.rglob('*.parquet')),'candidate_checkpoint_hashes':checkpoint_hashes,'formal_file_hashes':observed,'build_progress':built,'apply_progress':applied,'replay_progress':replay,'fake_source_requests':len(source.requests),'promotion_source_requests':0,'rejects':0,'business_differences':0}
(root/'evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ('total_rows','files','seconds','peak_rss_bytes','formal_parquet_bytes','fake_source_requests')},ensure_ascii=False))
